findings.finding: Peers that reported Q3 before NP3 still booked positive property value changes even though long yields rose: Wallenstam +107 MSEK in Q3 (377 a year earlier), and SLP, the closest industrial/logistics peer, +277 MSEK for 9M (264). So an NP3 Q3 write-down, which a sector down 15-19% since July partly prices, is less likely than flat to positive value changes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 value change +37 MSEK, stock -1.15% on the day; Q2 2026 +226 MSEK with a net-profit beat (EPS 5.27 vs 4.1 estimate), stock -0.37%. This name has not rewarded valuation beats
findings.original_quote: Värdeförändring förvaltningsfastigheter uppgår till 107 Mkr (377). [Wallenstam, 1 juli-30 september 2026] / SLP: 'Värdeförändringar för förvaltningsfastigheter om 277 mkr (264).' (Change in value of investment properties amounts to MSEK 107 (377) / MSEK 277 (264).)
findings.why_not_priced: The peer reports came out on the morning of the day before NP3's print, and NP3 still fell 1.79% on 10-15. Since 07-10 NP3 is down 18.8%, in line with Catena -16.9%, Platzer -18.6% and Fabege -15.2%: that is a sector valuation discount for rising yields. If the market had read the peers' positive Q3 marks as a read-through to NP3, NP3 would have firmed with Wallenstam (+2.3%) rather than fallen. Proxy only: Wallenstam is residential, SLP is southern logistics, and NP3 values in northern Sweden at a 6.9% yield.
findings.independence: Counter-evidence from a different source: Fastator wrote down Point Properties by ~150 MSEK on 2026-10-07 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bc65f1d5dff41e0c6c296a112ab2181de&lang=sv&src=listed). Supporting: NP3's own Oct 14 divestments went 34% above book (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bf15b4e5eceafb018cc02f3e3b53c5bc8&lang=en&src=listed), though small (MSEK 64) and low-occupancy assets

findings.finding: Over Q3 the Swedish 10-year government yield rose from 2.645% (2026-06-25) to 3.252% (2026-09-24). NP3 carries a MSEK 10,075 interest-rate derivative portfolio, so Q3 will show unrealised derivative gains (Q2 was -101 MSEK) and lift net profit after tax. Wallenstam's Q3 +578 MSEK on financial instruments confirms the direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 net profit beat the Yahoo EPS estimate by 28.5%, largely on value changes, and the stock fell 0.37%. Net-profit beats from revaluations are not rewarded here
findings.original_quote: Wallenstam Q3: 'Värdeförändring finansiella instrument uppgår till 578 Mkr (159).' (Change in value of financial instruments amounts to MSEK 578 (159).)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: rates are public and analysts model swap marks. Any surprise is in the headline EPS (Yahoo-type net-profit consensus), which a property investor looks through. If the market cared, NP3 would trade with the swap curve rather than against it, and it has fallen as yields rose. Sits below PfPM with no path to the forecast, so sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Wallenstam Q3 report, a different issuer (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/adaa3752932256e09e40778d2855c04c2). Derivative portfolio size from NP3's H1 report (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b01cd4f6df8d578c3ce9270b4a9e6d852&lang=en&src=listed)

findings.finding: The Q3 report will very likely nudge the FY2026 PfPM forecast up from MSEK 1,240. The Oct 14 acquisition (rental value MSEK 19.6, mostly accessed at the start of Q4) and the July MSEK 62 deal add a few MSEK, and NP3 has raised the forecast at every report in 2026 (1,180 to 1,220 to 1,240) and at Q3 2025 (1,090 to 1,100).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The forecast is mechanical (current portfolio plus announced deals), so anyone can compute the update from the Oct 14 release, and the stock fell 1.79% the day after it. Only a raise beyond the deal arithmetic, e.g. from lower financing costs after May's refinancing at STIBOR+200 vs +525, would be news, and there is no evidence of one.
findings.independence: The forecast-raise pattern is from NP3's Q3 2025, year-end 2025 and Q1 2026 reports (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/abf603f744ec0b16a84a2aed698d7cf83, https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/abe9868bfd836fd037e0b88a8f9695044)
